name: SOG Super SOG Bowie Fixed Blade Knife - 7.5-inch Straight Edge, Clip Point - Hardcased Black TiNi -
description: Super SOG Bowie Fixed Blade Knife Super-Sized Blade The Super SOG Bowie Fixed Blade Knife is a slightly larger version of the Bowie 2.0 Knife, featuring the same quality and integrity as its sibling. Modeled off of the knives used by US military during the Vietnam War, this amazing knife features a lengthy 7.5" straight edge clip point blade that is just a quarter-inch thick. The blade is made from durable AUS-8 steel and coated with a hard-cased Titanium Nitride finish, giving it incredible durability and a sleek look. The Super SOG Bowie features a full tang that goes through the entire handle, which is wrapped with brown leather washers for an improved grip. The knife comes with a special sharpening stone for when the blade ultimately begins to wear, as well as a snap-shut leather sheath that can be attached to your belt for easy carrying. name: Native Copper Knife with Whitetail Deer Bone Handle
description: Hand forged Copper Dagger. From early times simplicity and necessity gave way to greater and more complex creations. Examples of this process can be seen in the arts and crafts of many native people. Metal working in North America has often been overlooked due to the relative rarity of workable material,. However, the presence of float copper that could be worked from its natural state is one of few exceptions. This particular example has been smelted into an ingot, then hand forged to shape then cold forged to work harden the blade to a tougher more durable edge. Epoxy resin has been used to set the blade into the whitetail deer bone handle and simulated sinew used as a binding. The blade measures 5 7/8" with an overall length of 10 1/8".Made by Forged in Fire Contestant and Master of Arms Finalist Dustin Rhodes.
